name: SavingPodo
summary:
Game Overview:
SavingPodo is an immersive MR fitness game set in a magical fairy village. The cute and charming fairy village has been thrown into chaos by invading monsters. Join forces with the fairies who call for your help and defeat the monsters pouring through portals to save the village!

Gameplay:
Punch to Shoot Energy Balls: Players can defeat monsters by using real punching motions to shoot energy balls.
Duck to Evade Attacks: Avoid monster attacks by performing real ducking motions.
Squat to Reco
